**Fix committed. No final collection started.**

**New commit**

- `452215f73b092686b15cb6562f8dea4d071c3ac5` — "propagate CONNECT timeout into rumqttc options", 2 files, +37/−7.
- Diff: `mqtt_options(spec)` → `mqtt_options(spec, connect_timeout)` setting rumqttc internal to `timeout.saturating_add(CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MARGIN)` (5 s const with doc); `connect()` forwards its existing budget; `observed-mqtt-client` passes 10 s matching its outer loop; new regression test asserting 25 s → 30 s internal and ≠ 5 s default. Nothing else touched.

**Tests**

- `cargo test -p gen-tokens`: 80 passed, incl. new `mqtt_options_propagates_connect_timeout_above_library_default`. `cargo fmt --check`: clean. Clippy: 0 errors, 2 pre-existing warnings in untouched `mqtt-loadgen.rs`.

**Quarantined regression qualification (predetermined 6 runs, no retries)**

- LATENCY family (6 scenarios incl. TLS) × c10/m10 r1–r3 and c10/m100 r1–r3, all `--skip-build --skip-tokens`, each moved to `results-quarantine-regress-latconnfix-c10-m*-r*/` immediately.
- Result: 6/6 PASS — zero `connect_failed` (either casing) in any run or log, `connect.count=10` in all 36 JSONs, LAT1000 PDP timing intact (`publish` count=1000, p50 ≈ 10012–10018 ms; `connect_timeout_seconds=25` still the recorded budget).
- One operator-timeout kill of the first m100-r1 attempt at ~40 min (healthy, 3/6 scenarios done, both LAT1000 passed); orphans removed, partial cell discarded, r1 re-run from scratch to completion. No data selected.

**Hashes**

- New release `mqtt-loadgen`: `b3d4352bd5ef6f76969821230a09b15be9ecf901e0d0665bbcd5b85994e2696d` (was `4fdef568…`).
- Plugin `b8b05cfa…09994`, `tokens.json 78de5f0c…`, `password-map.json e6db4c97…` — **byte-identical** (no regen/rebuild). No other generated artifact changed (`Cargo.lock` untouched; only container images rebuilt from the fixed source at run time).
- All `results-final-p1-b23eb22-*` dirs untouched, unrenamed, not aggregated — superseded evidence as ordered.

Final collection under the new commit is not started; the campaign remains HOLD pending your re-freeze/collection orders.
